snippet.title: Soul's Remnant (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
Dive into the world of Soul's Remnant, a 2D platformer MMORPG inspired by classics like MapleStory, Ragnarok Online, and Mabinogi.

Soul's Remnant will be available in Early Access on Steam on August 13th! From this point, player progress will not be wiped.

Wishlist Soul's Remnant on Steam here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451980/Souls_Remnant/

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/soulsremnant

#MMORPG #IndieGame #WishlistOnSteam #SoulsRemnant
